t: You're looking at the Park Lane Hotel, now the Sheraton Grand London Park Lane, a five-star hotel on Piccadilly. It was commissioned by Sir Bracewell Smith, who was a businessman, a Conservative politician and the Lord Mayor of London. He lived from 1884 to 1966. The banker Rupert Beckett, who lived from 1870 to 1955, died here. So this is a grand hotel with a civic figure behind it, standing in one of the best-known parts of the West End.
